industry: Measuring, Medical, Optical and Related Instruments

instrument_device_family.label: Instrument / device family
instrument_device_family.value: Dexcom G7 continuous glucose monitoring systems and Stelo over-the-counter glucose biosensors.

measurement_performance_specification.label: Measurement / performance specification
measurement_performance_specification.value: G7 delivers real-time glucose readings every few minutes with customizable alerts. Stelo continuously measures and displays glucose.

clinical_industrial_research_use.label: Clinical / industrial / research use
clinical_industrial_research_use.value: G7 supports type 1, type 2 and gestational diabetes management. Stelo helps adults who do not use insulin understand how lifestyle affects glucose.

product_specific_regulatory_status.label: Product-specific regulatory status
product_specific_regulatory_status.value: FDA 510(k)-cleared G7 systems, including the extended-wear model, and FDA 510(k)-cleared over-the-counter Stelo.

consumables_service_attachment.label: Consumables / service attachment
consumables_service_attachment.value: Replaceable glucose sensors with companion smartphone apps and a receiver option for G7.

calibration_qualification_requirement.label: Calibration / qualification requirement
calibration_qualification_requirement.value: Factory-calibrated G7 and Stelo sensors. G7 supports optional calibration with a blood glucose meter.
